clOrderId.description: Echo of the client-supplied order identifier if one was provided

status.description: Numeric status code reflecting the current state of the order (e.g. filled, cancelled, rejected)

type.description: Numeric code identifying the order type (e.g. LIMIT, MARKET, TWAP, PEG)

postOnly.description: Whether the order was submitted as post-only

timestamp.description: Server-side event timestamp in epoch milliseconds

orderDetailType.description: Detailed order sub-type when applicable (e.g. TWAP for algo TWAP orders)

message.description: Optional diagnostic message; present only when one is returned (e.g. rejection reason)

userQuoteCurrency.description: Quote currency configured for the user

orderCurrency.description: 'quote' or 'base'; indicates whether the quote-size or base-size fields below are populated

originalOrderBaseSize.description: Original size in base currency; populated when orderCurrency is 'base'

originalOrderQuoteSize.description: Original size in quote currency; populated when orderCurrency is 'quote'

currentOrderBaseSize.description: Currently active size in base currency; populated when orderCurrency is 'base'

currentOrderQuoteSize.description: Currently active size in quote currency; populated when orderCurrency is 'quote'

remainingOrderBaseSize.description: Remaining unfilled size in base currency; populated when orderCurrency is 'base'

remainingOrderQuoteSize.description: Remaining unfilled size in quote currency; populated when orderCurrency is 'quote'

filledBaseSize.description: Size filled by the most recent match, in base currency

totalFilledBaseSize.description: Cumulative filled size across all matches, in base currency

time_in_force.description: Time-in-force policy (GTC, IOC, FOK); null when not applicable to the order type
